ngaap.guidance: From Q1-23 base business core growth will exclude COVID-19 testing, vaccines and therapeutics revenue. Q1-23: core sales -mid-single digit; COVID-19 impact +high-single to low-double digit; base business core +mid-single digit. FY2023: core -mid-single digit; COVID impact +low-double digit; base business core +high-single digit. No EPS guidance.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS adds back pretax amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, fair value (gains) losses on equity and limited partnership investments, impairments and other charges, pension settlement losses, acquisition-related items, product-line disposition gains and contract settlement expense, then deducts the aggregate tax effect and removes discrete tax items. MCPS: per-share adjustments assume all MCPS converted ('if-converted' regardless of dilution); adjusted diluted shares = GAAP diluted shares + converted shares of anti-dilutive MCPS, and the related MCPS dividends are added back. Q4-22: MCPS Series B dilutive in GAAP diluted EPS (745.7m shares, no converted shares added). Large discrete tax benefit ($452m, -0.61/share) from business realignment drove GAAP tax benefit of 39. New item: separation costs for the planned EAS separation. FY2022 adjusted EPS 10.95 (GAAP 9.66).
